question: Estimate the size of the Indian Diaspora-marketing addressable segment (urban Indians with abroad-relevant intent — visa, study abroad, travel, remittances).
idealClarificationQuestions: Urban Indians actively planning or transacting on abroad-relevant services? Yes.
Categories: study abroad, work visas, foreign tourism, remittance senders/receivers, dual citizenship buyers? Yes.

calculationFlow: Indians annually applying for foreign student visas: ~14 lakh.
Indians annually traveling abroad (international tourism outbound): ~3.5 crore trips (~2 crore unique).
Indians actively planning to migrate / work abroad (visa applications): ~1 crore individuals over 5-year horizon = ~20 lakh actively in pipeline.
Indians receiving inward remittances or sending: ~5-7 crore connected to NRIs.
Total unique addressable segment for diaspora-marketing services (study abroad, visa, forex, foreign property, dual citizenship advisory): ~4-5 crore individuals.
Annual market: ₹50,000-60,000 Cr (visa fees, forex margins, study abroad commissions, advisory).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Annual market: ₹50,000-60,000 Cr (visa fees, forex margins, study abroad commissions, advisory).
